title: GLASS ADJUSTMENT PROCEDURE
summary: Coupe (19437) side door glass adjustment, 19 steps: fit the windshield-side weatherstrip and retainer, set the door glass with its guide cams, idler cams, anti-rattle cushions and up/down stops against gage blocks at the rear roof seal rabbit, fit the rear glass weatherstrip, then recheck door fit, glass engagement and roof panel weatherstrip after the body is mounted to the frame. Sections and View A are on the next sheet (K13).

fastening.to: birdcage (windshield pillar), through the w/shield side w/strip retainer
fastening.note: Hold the w/shield side w/strip retainer. Step 1: lower two started loose. Step 8: after drilling the upper birdcage hole via the w/strip clearance hole, torque all three.

Guide cam upper bolts: two on the front cam (step 6a, once front-edge engagement and parallelism are set, Section A-A), two on the rear cam (step 9b, once the rear edge meets the gage blocks, View A). Step 18, after body drop: loosen all four (plus both "D") to reset tumble home, i.e. lateral glass-to-w/strip interference.
Two idler cam bolts (step 6b). Step 14, after body drop: loosen to correct the glass front-edge angle to the w/shield side w/strip, then retorque.

Locks each anti-rattle cushion. Step 7: front cushion pressed outboard firmly onto the glass, then torqued. Step 9c: rear cushion bolt; cushion setting fine-tunes the fit to the gage blocks. Step 18: loosened along with bolts "B" to reset tumble home.
Two screws for the front and rear upper stops; stops set against the window rollers, then torqued (step 16). Sets glass full-up height.
Three screws "F" set the glass fore and aft relationship (step 15).
Rear guide cam lower bolt (step 9a); the cam is adjusted at the belt line until the glass rear edge touches both gage blocks on the rear roof seal rabbit (View A).
Two screws for the lower stop: with the glass top edge lowered flush to the door outer panel, set the stop to the roller and torque (step 17).

notes: ON TRIM LINE BEFORE BODY DROP
1. Fit the w/shield side w/strip retainer; start only its lower two screws "A", loose.
2. Glue the w/shield side w/strip into the retainer, its top trim line flush to the header molding's upper outer corner. Keep cement off the back of the w/strip above the retainer.
3. Hang the side door glass and its related parts; leave the bolts into the door inner panel loose.
4. Raise the glass until its front corner sits about .50 in. under the header molding's front upper corner.
5. Slide the glass forward just enough to start it into the w/shield side w/strip's groove.

6. At the belt line, press glass and w/strip retainer outboard until the glass's nylon stabilizer button meets the inner panel's wedge surface. Keep the glass front edge engaged in, and parallel to, the w/strip (Section A-A). Torque: a. front guide cam upper bolts "B" (2); b. idler cam bolts "C" (2).
7. Press the front anti-rattle cushion outboard until it bears firmly on the glass; torque bolt "D".

8. Lower the glass to reach the retainer screws. Put cement on the header molding's upper corner. Through the w/strip's clearance hole, drill the upper mounting hole in the birdcage. Torque all three screws "A".

9. At the belt line, adjust the rear guide cam so the glass rear edge touches both gage blocks on the rear roof seal rabbit (View A); fine-tune with the rear anti-rattle cushion. Torque: a. rear guide cam lower bolt "G"; b. rear guide cam upper bolts "B" (2); c. rear anti-rattle cushion bolt "D".

10. Take out the gage blocks and fit the side door glass rear w/strip, locating its molded lower end on the lock pillar. With the door shut, match the rear w/strip's lower face to the top face of the door w/strip (Section E-E), then cement the section above the belt line onto the w/strip retainer, upper flange tucked beneath the rear roof molding. Open the door; seal and cement the lower part to the lock pillar.
AFTER BODY DROP
11. Fit the front roof panel as needed to suit the rest of the body (Section B-B). Attach the side w/strip loosely to the roof panel beforehand.
12. Check door-to-body fit and lock-to-striker alignment; fix any misalignment caused by mounting the body on the frame.

13. Raise the glass to give at least .06 swing clearance to the side w/strip's outer lip. Using the final height setting, shift the glass fore or aft for the correct interference fit with the w/shield side w/strip (Section A-A).

14. Recheck that the glass front edge is parallel to the w/shield side w/strip, in case body mounting threw it off. If not, loosen both bolts "C", correct the angle, and retorque. When doing this, hold the step 13 setting at the same time.
15. Torque the three screws "F" to lock the fore/aft position.
16. Bring the front and rear upper stops against the window rollers; torque both screws "E".
17. Lower the glass until its top edge sits flush with the door outer panel. Bring the lower stop against the roller and torque both screws "H".

18. Raise the glass fully and check whether body mounting changed the side-to-side glass-to-w/strip interference. If so, loosen the four bolts "B" and two bolts "D", reset the tumble home, and retorque.
19. Move the roof panel side w/strip in or out for correct seal compression and so it runs parallel to the glass upper edge (Section C-C).
NOTE See Sheet K11.
